learned.title: ADR-005: Lantern outbound retry policy

learned.title: Lantern JSON serialization: Decimal as string via serde_as_string

learned.title: ADR-007: Lantern amounts use rust_decimal::Decimal, no floating point
learned.knowledge: As of 12 May 2026, all monetary amounts in the Lantern service must use `rust_decimal::Decimal`. Floating-point types (`f32`/`f64`) are strictly forbidden for amounts. This decision was recorded as ADR-007, triggered by a rounding incident in batch #4471.

learned.title: Sqlx compile-time query checking requires live DB schema

learned.title: Migrations are append-only; never edit applied migrations
